instruction: Make a folder on the browser's bookmarks bar and give it the name 'Daily Sites'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Daily Sites' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_bookmarks) correctly reads Chrome bookmarks from the Bookmarks file and returns the complete bookmark structure
Metric (is_expected_bookmarks with type=bookmark_bar_folders_names) correctly extracts folder names from bookmark_bar children and checks if 'Daily Sites' is present using subset check
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires - existence of a folder named 'Daily Sites' on the bookmarks bar
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are flushed to disk before verification
Expected value ['Daily Sites'] semantically matches the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: get_bookmarks -> bookmark structure -> is_expected_bookmarks extracts folders -> subset check for 'Daily Sites'
Edge cases handled properly: empty bookmarks returns 0, wrong folder name returns 0, multiple folders correctly identified using subset check
